# dualect

> Translates numeric code between .m files (Octave/MATLAB style) and Python/NumPy
> in both directions, one tested rule per construct, and verifies every
> translation by running both sides.

Each rule lives in `rules/<category>/<rule-id>/`: `rule.yaml` explains the
difference between the languages (`why`, `pitfalls`) for a human or an LLM,
`translate.py` holds the deterministic translators, and `cases/` holds `.m` /
`.py` pairs that run in both languages. A rule's status is given per direction:
`mechanical` (translated by its `translate.py`, every case verified), `guided`
(an LLM applies the rule; the result is verified) or `unsupported`. Use
`dualect scan FILE` for the rules a file needs and `dualect context FILE` for
them as prompt context; the MCP server (`dualect mcp`) offers the same as tools.
Generated by `dualect llms-txt`; do not edit by hand.

## Rules

- [builtins/constants](rules/builtins/constants/rule.yaml): Constants: `pi`, `Inf`, `NaN`, `eps`, `true`, `false`, `i` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [builtins/elementwise-math](rules/builtins/elementwise-math/rule.yaml): Element-wise math: `abs`, `sqrt`, `exp`, `floor`, `mod`, `rem`, `isnan`, ... (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [builtins/filter](rules/builtins/filter/rule.yaml): `filter`: one-dimensional digital filter (`scipy.signal.lfilter`) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [builtins/find](rules/builtins/find/rule.yaml): `find`: 1-based, column-major indices (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [builtins/isempty](rules/builtins/isempty/rule.yaml): `isempty` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: n/a; 1 case)
- [builtins/linspace](rules/builtins/linspace/rule.yaml): `linspace` default count and edge cases (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [builtins/size-numel-length](rules/builtins/size-numel-length/rule.yaml): `size`, `numel`, `length` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [builtins/sum-mean-max](rules/builtins/sum-mean-max/rule.yaml): `sum`, `mean`, `max`, `min`: dimensions and index outputs (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [builtins/zeros-ones-eye](rules/builtins/zeros-ones-eye/rule.yaml): `zeros`, `ones`, `eye` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [control-flow/for-columns](rules/control-flow/for-columns/rule.yaml): `for` loops iterate over columns (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [control-flow/if-elseif](rules/control-flow/if-elseif/rule.yaml): `if` / `elseif` / `else` and array conditions (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [control-flow/switch](rules/control-flow/switch/rule.yaml): `switch` / `case` / `otherwise` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [control-flow/while](rules/control-flow/while/rule.yaml): `while` loops and Octave's `do ... until` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [functions/definition](rules/functions/definition/rule.yaml): Function definitions and argument copy semantics (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [functions/multiple-returns](rules/functions/multiple-returns/rule.yaml): Multiple return values and `nargout` (.m to Python: guided; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [functions/nargin](rules/functions/nargin/rule.yaml): Optional arguments with `nargin` (.m to Python: guided; Python to .m: guided; 1 case)
- [indexing/colon-all](rules/indexing/colon-all/rule.yaml): `A(:)`: all elements as one column (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [indexing/end-in-index](rules/indexing/end-in-index/rule.yaml): `end` inside an index expression (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [indexing/grow-on-assign](rules/indexing/grow-on-assign/rule.yaml): Growing an array by assigning past its end (.m to Python: guided; Python to .m: guided; 2 cases)
- [indexing/logical](rules/indexing/logical/rule.yaml): Logical (mask) indexing (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [indexing/one-based](rules/indexing/one-based/rule.yaml): One-based indexing and column-major linear indices (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [indexing/ranges](rules/indexing/ranges/rule.yaml): Colon ranges `a:b` and `a:step:b` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [io/display](rules/io/display/rule.yaml): Display of results: a missing `;` and `display` (.m to Python: guided; Python to .m: n/a; 1 case)
- [io/printf](rules/io/printf/rule.yaml): Formatted output: `printf`, `fprintf`, `sprintf`, `disp` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 3 cases)
- [operators/arithmetic](rules/operators/arithmetic/rule.yaml): `+`, `-`, comparisons and implicit expansion (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [operators/augmented-assignment](rules/operators/augmented-assignment/rule.yaml): `x += e`, `x++` and friends (Octave only) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/division](rules/operators/division/rule.yaml): `/`, `./` and `\`: true division and linear solves (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/matrix-multiply](rules/operators/matrix-multiply/rule.yaml): `*` (matrix product) vs `.*` (element-wise) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/not-equal](rules/operators/not-equal/rule.yaml): `~=` / `!=` and logical NOT `~` / `!` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/power](rules/operators/power/rule.yaml): `^` (matrix power) vs `.^` (element-wise power) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/short-circuit](rules/operators/short-circuit/rule.yaml): `&&`/`||` (short-circuit) vs `&`/`|` (element-wise) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [operators/transpose](rules/operators/transpose/rule.yaml): `'` (conjugate transpose) vs `.'` (transpose) (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [syntax/array-literals](rules/syntax/array-literals/rule.yaml): Bracket literals: rows, columns, matrices, `[]` and concatenation (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 2 cases)
- [syntax/command-syntax](rules/syntax/command-syntax/rule.yaml): Command syntax: `name arg1 arg2` vs `name('arg1', 'arg2')` (.m to Python: guided; Python to .m: n/a; 1 case)
- [syntax/comments](rules/syntax/comments/rule.yaml): Comments: `%`, `#`, and `%{ ... %}` blocks (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [syntax/line-continuation](rules/syntax/line-continuation/rule.yaml): Line continuation with `...` (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: n/a; 1 case)
- [types/char-strings](rules/types/char-strings/rule.yaml): Char arrays `'...'` and double-quoted strings (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
- [types/double](rules/types/double/rule.yaml): `double` and `logical`: converting between numbers and truth values (.m to Python: mechanical; Python to .m: mechanical; 1 case)
